text: Anritsu Corporation is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market (code 6754); at 31 March 2023 its largest shareholders were The Master Trust Bank of Japan (trust account, 15.90%) and Custody Bank of Japan (trust account, 6.90%).
